highlights.reason_zh: GPT-6.1 Sol 已开放 API，价格和能力会直接影响主力模型路由。
highlights.reason_en: GPT-6.1 Sol is API-available and directly changes workhorse model routing.

highlights.reason_zh: Dots 把跨对话持续工作的 agent 做成真实产品，但计价和治理仍待明确。
highlights.reason_en: Dots productize agents that work between conversations, while pricing and governance remain unsettled.

highlights.reason_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 的 1M 输出 token 展示新上限，但公开验证尚不可做。
highlights.reason_en: Gemini 4 Argon shows a 1M-output ceiling but cannot yet be publicly tested.

highlights.reason_zh: Olmo-core 3 提供少见的开放万亿参数 MoE 训练参考栈。
highlights.reason_en: Olmo-core 3 is a rare open reference stack for trillion-parameter MoE training.

highlights.reason_zh: cua-speedrun 让 computer-use 的速度与成本结论可以低成本复现。
highlights.reason_en: cua-speedrun makes computer-use speed and cost claims cheaply reproducible.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部抓取并读完；另完成官方页面、release notes 与公开研究产物核查。到期复核中无法在本次确认的项目保持 pending。
